note: Performance target, warning, and regression-gate SSOT. target answers whether the product is good enough; warning marks a material miss; gate prevents a regression and is evaluated independently. Same-machine timing targets apply only to the declared profile. Ratchet baselines are measured values; tolerancePct is the cumulative growth budget. Lower a Gate in the same PR after a durable win; a PR that loosens one needs the perf-baseline label.
